entries.headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong connected at +291
entries.story: Pete Crow-Armstrong cashed. Facing Reynaldo López, he went deep in the 6th in his 4th at bat. The call: "Pete Crow-Armstrong homers (42) on a fly ball to right center field. Carson Kelly scores." Final line: 4-for-5.

entries.headline: Hunter Goodman came close
entries.story: Hunter Goodman went 2-for-3 with 1 BB against Casey Mize and the San Diego Padres. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "Hunter Goodman doubles (19) on a ground ball to left fielder Dustin Harris." The power showed up; the carry did not.
